cues.en: So, before we can go too far, of course, we need to have the appropriate version of Python installed in our systems, and there's lots of ways to do that.
cues.zh: 在繼續之前，當然得先在系統安裝適當版本的 Python，而安裝方式有很多種。

cues.en: But the way I'm going to do it in this course is using something called pyenv, and you can see it right here on GitHub.
cues.zh: 不過這門課會使用一個叫做 pyenv 的工具，這裡可以在 GitHub 上看到它。

cues.en: It's just github.com slash pyenv slash pyenv, okay?
cues.zh: 網址就是 github.com/pyenv/pyenv。

cues.en: And the great thing about this package is that it allows us to install any version of Python we want without actually touching the one that's the main Python installation for our system, if any, okay?
cues.zh: 這個套件的優點是，可以安裝任何想要的 Python 版本，而不動到系統原本的主要 Python 安裝，如果系統有的話。

cues.en: So what we need to do is to install this, and you can scroll down here, and it shows you exactly how to install it, and the easiest way on Mac is right here, okay?
cues.zh: 我們需要先安裝它。往下捲就能看到完整安裝方式；Mac 上最簡單的方法就在這裡。

cues.en: I'm going to click on Homebrew in Mac OS, and that will give us the necessary instructions.
cues.zh: 我點選 macOS 的 Homebrew 連結，就會看到所需的安裝指示。

cues.en: So I'll just go over to the Mac OS part here and expand that, and what we want to do is to install Homebrew.
cues.zh: 接著到 macOS 的部分展開說明，先安裝 Homebrew。

cues.en: And if you don't have Homebrew, just follow this link right here, okay, and it will actually show you the one command you need to install Homebrew.
cues.zh: 如果還沒安裝 Homebrew，就點這裡的連結，頁面會顯示安裝 Homebrew 所需的那一行指令。

cues.en: And once you have that done, brew update to get the latest version of everything so we know what's out there, and then we install pyenv, okay?
cues.zh: 完成後執行 brew update，更新可用套件資訊，再安裝 pyenv。

cues.en: And that's really, really simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: Now, if you're on Windows, we'll go over here, and you'll see there's a fork of this called pyenv-win, and it's really easy to install as well, okay?
cues.zh: 如果使用 Windows，這裡有一個名為 pyenv-win 的分支版本，安裝起來也很容易。

cues.en: So just scroll down, find the necessary installation instructions right here, okay, and you can
cues.zh: 往下捲，找到這裡的安裝指示，就能

cues.en: install pyenv, and once you have that installed, just fire up your favorite terminal, and it's really simple.
cues.zh: 安裝 pyenv。安裝完成後開啟你慣用的終端機，接下來操作很簡單。

cues.en: So first of all, let's see what versions of Python are available to us, and as you might expect, there's quite a few.
cues.zh: 首先，看看有哪些 Python 版本可以安裝。如你所想，版本相當多。

cues.en: So I type pyenv install-l, that's a lowercase l, and that will list all of the various versions
cues.zh: 輸入 pyenv install -l，這裡是小寫的 l，就能列出所有

cues.en: that are out there, and as you can see, there are a lot.
cues.zh: 可用版本；可以看到，真的有很多。

cues.en: And the one that I want is 3.12, so let's find 3.12 and see what versions they have for that.
cues.zh: 我要的是 3.12，所以找到 3.12，看看有哪些版本。

cues.en: So it'll be Python or just the numbers, here it is, 3.12.9 or 3.12.10, let's go with 3.12.9, that's a pretty stable version, okay, so that's the one I want.
cues.zh: 這裡是版本號：3.12.9 或 3.12.10。我們用 3.12.9，這是相當穩定的版本，就選它。

cues.en: So I'll just clear the screen and type pyenv install 3.12.9, and that will go and get it if I don't already have it.
cues.zh: 先清除畫面，再輸入 pyenv install 3.12.9。如果還沒安裝，工具就會下載它。

cues.en: So it pulls it down, it installs it, and we're pretty much ready to use it.
cues.zh: 下載、安裝後，基本上就可以使用了。

cues.en: So I'll just wait for that to install.
cues.zh: 我等它安裝完成。

cues.en: And there, finished.
cues.zh: 好了，完成了。

cues.en: It took about two minutes for me, but it's available.
cues.zh: 我這裡大約花了兩分鐘，現在已經可以使用。

cues.en: So now I have that installed.
cues.zh: 所以，這個版本已經安裝好了。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do now is clear the screen, and I'll go to the desktop, okay, just to show you how this works.
cues.zh: 現在清除畫面，切換到桌面，示範一下它如何運作。

cues.en: And I'll make a directory called pyreg, and that's what I'm going to use for the development in this course, okay, so we'll just create a directory named pyreg.
cues.zh: 我會建立一個叫做 pyrag 的目錄，作為這門課的開發專案目錄。先建立這個目錄。

cues.en: And now I want to specify the version of Python I want to use.
cues.zh: 接著，我要指定使用的 Python 版本。

cues.en: So I'll clear the screen again, and I'll say pyenv local 3.12.9.
cues.zh: 再清除畫面，輸入 pyenv local 3.12.9。

cues.en: So that says for this directory, the one named pyreg, I want to use Python 3.12.9, okay.
cues.zh: 這表示在目前名為 pyrag 的目錄中，我要使用 Python 3.12.9。

cues.en: And now I actually need to activate that, or create a virtual environment.
cues.zh: 現在還需要啟用環境，或者說，建立一個虛擬環境。

cues.en: So the standard way of doing that in Python is to use the command python dash m, and then I want to have a virtual environment, venv.
cues.zh: Python 標準做法是執行 python -m，再指定 venv 來建立虛擬環境。

cues.en: And I'll create that in a directory called .venv, okay.
cues.zh: 我要把它建立在 .venv 目錄中。

cues.en: You can call the directory whatever you want, but I like to call it .venv so I don't accidentally commit it to git.
cues.zh: 目錄可以取任何名稱，但我喜歡用 .venv，避免不小心把它提交到 Git。

cues.en: And that will actually create the virtual environment, okay.
cues.zh: 這樣就會建立虛擬環境。

cues.en: But it's still not the active virtual environment.
cues.zh: 但它還不是目前啟用的虛擬環境。

cues.en: Now how do I activate this local virtual environment?
cues.zh: 那要怎麼啟用這個本機虛擬環境？

cues.en: Well it depends what you're on.
cues.zh: 這取決於你使用的系統。

cues.en: If you're on a Mac or Linux, you can just say source.venv, that directory I just created, slash bin slash activate, okay.
cues.zh: 如果是 Mac 或 Linux，輸入 source .venv/bin/activate；.venv 就是剛建立的目錄。

cues.en: And that will actually activate it.
cues.zh: 這樣就會啟用它。

cues.en: And you can see that now in my particular shell, I have the .venv in parentheses on the left-hand side, and that tells me that I'm in the virtual environment.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我目前的 shell 左側出現括號中的 .venv，表示已進入虛擬環境。

cues.en: Now if you're in Windows, it's a little bit different.
cues.zh: 如果使用 Windows，操作稍微不同。

cues.en: You type .venv, or whatever you called your directory, and then a backslash, and then
cues.zh: 輸入 .venv，或者你替目錄取的名稱，再接一個反斜線，然後

cues.en: scripts with a capital S, and then a backslash, and then activate, activate.bat.
cues.zh: 輸入首字母大寫的 Scripts、反斜線，再接 activate.bat。

cues.en: Now clearly that won't work for me because I'm on a Mac right now.
cues.zh: 當然，這個指令在我這裡不會成功，因為我現在用的是 Mac。

cues.en: But if I enter that, and I'm using cmd.exe, okay, on a Windows machine, that'll activate it for Windows.
cues.zh: 但如果在 Windows 的 cmd.exe 中輸入，就會啟用 Windows 虛擬環境。

cues.en: But if you're in PowerShell, it's a little bit different.
cues.zh: 如果使用 PowerShell，則又有些不同。

cues.en: So .venv, .venv, or whatever you called that directory, scripts, and then activate with a capital A, activate, .ps, and the number one.
cues.zh: 輸入 .venv，或者你取的目錄名，再接 Scripts，以及首字母大寫的 Activate.ps1。

cues.en: So make a note of whichever command you need to use, okay, because I'm going to be using the one for a Mac throughout the remainder of this course.
cues.zh: 請記下適合自己系統的指令，因為接下來整門課我都會使用 Mac 的指令。

cues.en: And every time I activate it, I might be using a different command than you.
cues.zh: 每次啟用時，我用的指令可能跟你的不同。

cues.en: So write this down on a sticky note or something so it's easy to find.
cues.zh: 所以可以寫在便利貼之類的地方，方便隨時查看。

cues.en: Now, one obvious question, if I'm in my virtual environment, and I want to get out of it, how do I do that?
cues.zh: 另一個很自然的問題是：如果已經在虛擬環境裡，想離開要怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, it's simple. Deactivate. Okay?
cues.zh: 很簡單，輸入 deactivate。

cues.en: And that takes me out.
cues.zh: 這樣就會退出。

cues.en: Now, the great thing about Pyonv is it means I can have any version of Python I want for any particular project I'm working on, and keep everything nice and isolated and clean. Okay?
cues.zh: pyenv 的優點是，每個專案都能使用想要的 Python 版本，彼此保持隔離，而且乾淨整齊。

cues.en: So that's pretty straightforward. Let's move on.
cues.zh: 這很容易理解，我們繼續吧。
